# cv-discovered-team-series, nine reps -- vendored real proof data

19 real, recorded attempt files (9 reps of `cv-discovered-team-series`,
two turns each, rep5 carrying one extra retried attempt at t2) for
CHAOS-5620's family/window audit. Each file is byte-identical to the
corresponding file at `corpus-run-760014f7/replicate/` (sha256s in
`SHA256SUMS`, generated by `sha256sum` against the source at vendor time --
not hand-typed). No secrets: contents were grepped for
password/api-key/secret/token/bearer/dsn/authorization before vendoring, no
hits (`claimed_facts`, subject labels, and question text are the sensitive
surface here, and none of those are credentials).

Consumed by `corpus/test_semantic_verdict_proof.py`, which replays them
through `semantic_verdict.audit_window_exchange()` and asserts the exact
published columns this ticket's design of record measured
(`family_relation`: changed=3/same=6; `window_binding`: verified=9;
`family_confirmation`: unavailable=9).

This is fixture data for testing THIS repository's audit logic, not a
production corpus proof artefact and not the pinned 36-row baseline (that
stays `corpus/baseline-20260905-sweep1.json`, untouched).
